i386.note: System V i386, modelled as i686 with SSE2 (CMPXCHG8B, SSE2 scalar float): 64-bit scalars are 4-aligned inside structs; f32/f64 are still returned in x87 st(0)

msp430.note: MSP430: atomics by interrupt masking (single core declared)

avr.note: AVR: every scalar is 1-aligned; address 0 is a valid I/O location; atomics by interrupt masking (single core declared)

avr-xt.note: AVR-0/1 (AVRxt, ATmega4809): every scalar is 1-aligned; 16-bit registers are written low byte first (TEMP); peripherals at 0x0000-0x0FFF; atomics by interrupt masking (single core declared)

ppc32.note: PowerPC 32-bit SysV (big-endian): 64-bit scalars are 8-aligned; no lock-free 8-byte atomics

cheri-rv64.note: model only: capability 16 bytes, address 8 bytes (no oracle here)

cheriot.note: model only: capability 8 bytes, address 4 bytes, no atomic extension assumed: masking (no oracle here)
